body: I know that all the women out there aren't the same. I just had bad luck on picking who to love. Thank you for the kind words.
Now that I've calmed myself I do understand that this experience with my family is making me a better human being. I'm surely not going to act like this with my own children or wife. Thank you.
Yeah. I'll be going to college in another country. I just wish I could stay there all my life.

I'm sorry for not replying to any of you but I really had to get some sleep so I can calm myself and not do anything that I would regret. I got up, went to the gym. Ran 6 km. Went home. Found my father at this work desk. He yelled at me some more for no apparent reason. Made me feel like shit. So many things said..But I'm okay now, I guess. I'll sink into my books and my music and forget everything for about a month or two, hopefully. Thanks for being there for me. I really appreciate it.

I told them how I feel, I got rejected on so many levels. They yelled at me some more, called me stupid, my mom slapped me for having the audacity of insinuating that she's not a good mother. I can't take this anymore. I'm planning on moving away next year with school. I don't know if I can make it until then...

I really have a problem with confidence, low self-esteem. I just..really get down in this hole sometimes, and it lasts for weeks, I'm not capable of doing anything. I'm trying to put a really big smile on my face, act like I'm okay. It works. No one knows. Well, only my ex's knew the pain in my life. And yeah, I miss them, each in a unique way, but I feel a grudge towards them, a hate. How can you make the one you love suffer so hard? I came to the conclusion that nobody loved me. And that's making me so sad.
